text.p: Benfica captain Joao Vieira Pinto has been suspended for two games after being sent off last weekend, adding to the woes of the Portuguese club.
Benfica's Brazilian coach Paulo Autuori resigned on Monday night saying that he had to take responsibility for the club's recent poor form.
The Lisbon club, which began the season with high hopes of stopping champions Porto winning a third successive title, are second in the table but 11 points behind their northern rivals.
According to TSF radio, Maritimo coach Manuel Jose Silva had been appointed to take over from Autuori, who was in his first season with Benfica, but the report could not be immediately confirmed.
Vieira Pinto, 25, who recently signed a contract "for life" with Benfica, was suspended by the league disciplinary committee after being expelled for arguing with the referee.
